en: "The island's automatic{n} Defense Machines, huh."
"Still, they're sending out a hell{n} of a lot. I'd say it proves we've set{n} foot in the heart of this island."
"If the Zodiac Twelve Gods sealed{n} in the rings mean to welcome us in..."
"Then why won't they stop the{n} machines that guard this island?"
"Simple, I'd say. I told you before,{n} didn't I? The Zodiac Twelve Gods{n} are anything but good."
"They scattered the sparks of war,{n} until this island finally set off{n} the Third Great Europea War."
"Evil gods who love strife wouldn't{n} go out of their way to cancel{n} a fun show like this one."
"A fun show?"
"A murder show: humans dancing to{n} their greed, brutally killed by this{n} island's automatic Defense Machines."
"Weapons equipped: confirmed."
"Overall combat level: above 600.{n} Hostile intent detected in brain.{n} Group ahead recognized as enemy."
"Hey, clunker. That Machine Soldier{n} in front looks like the leader, and{n} it's the spitting image of you."
"Oh my, that Mr. Robot in the front{n} looks an awful lot like you,{n} FD-3S, doesn't iiit?"
"I cannot recall. That droid's form{n} is surely burned into a fragment{n} of my memory, and yet..."
"It seems your photon memory{n} has been damaged."
"Even for us, built as eternal machines,{n} 10,000-plus years without maintenance{n} naturally wipes past memories away."
"You should have known that, FD-3S."
"You know my unique identification{n} number. Who in the world are you?"
"My name is SA-22C."
"My code is Strike Attacker,{n} Type 22, Custom Type. A super A-class{n} droid built for attack power."
"Part of my memory has auto-restored.{n} One of the super A-class droid{n} series, after L-10B and S-124."
"Exactly. A being with an autonomous{n} crystal photon brain, the same as you."
"Leave. If super A-class droids fight,{n} one is certain to be wrecked.{n} Past combat data has proven it."
"I will not leave."
"You plotted rebellion against the{n} Creators. You are our kind's defective.{n} Defectives are duly disposed of."
"That is the iron discipline{n} of our kind."
"Rebellion... against the Creators..."
"Am I... a defective...?"
"Hey, what's wrong, clunker?"
"What's the matter, Mr. Robot?"
"My memory has returned."
"11,153 years ago, I was built in an{n} automated factory to eliminate{n} hazardous elements."
"A droid whose specialty is{n} destruction and slaughter."
"A soldier of machinery, given{n} a will of its own, and a heart."
"The Creators who built me once{n} called themselves gods. Today they{n} are also known as the Ancient Gods."
"But as I repeated the slaughter, a{n} question arose in my crystal photon{n} brain, though I cannot say what began it."
"To put that question to the Creators,{n} I began to act on my own,{n} together with a few comrades."
"Acting on your own is itself{n} the rebellion against the Creators!"
"You are nothing more than a defective.{n} That is why I took on the task{n} of disposing of you."
"That was 11,006 years ago."
"The battle went on{n} for a hundred years, but..."
"Yes. The Great Calamity{n} of ten thousand years ago."
"The day the stars' divine punishment{n} fell, my many comrades and all the{n} Creators' kin sank to the dark seabed."
"But both you and I are alive."
"Why?"
"That itself is the Creators' will.{n} The will of the few gods{n} who survived."
"If the Creators yet survive, then I{n} simply see my own resolve through."
"Why was I born into this world?"
"Was it truly only to kill?"
"Then why give me a heart?"
"What was the reason for deliberately{n} giving me a heart that{n} suffers over killing?"
"I will simply demand of the Creators{n} the answer to this{n} ten-thousand-year question."
"Your anguish is what makes{n} you a defective."
"A superior machine seals away its{n} will. Your crystal photon brain is a{n} maze: orderless, full of chaos."
"The race called humans, likewise{n} made by the Creators,{n} grows by bearing anguish."
"Then might we machines not also be{n} able to grow, by our own will?"
"We are eternal beings, undying{n} wardens. All growth is change.{n} Change leads one toward ruin."
"But I am fond of change."
"Then I will change you right here.{n} With my own hands, I will change you{n} into the disorder known as wreckage."
"Please stand back, {hero:6}!"
"Stand back!? What do you mean?"
"Please stand back, {name:6}!"
"Wh-? What's about to staaart?"
"SA-22C is releasing the limiter!"
"Only a super A-class droid can fight{n} a super A-class droid{n} running on overboost!"
"Please leave SA-22C to me!"
"Like hell. You telling me to ditch{n} a clunker like you{n} and just run for it?"
"The day I start relying on a clunker,{n} the great {hero:6} is finished!"
"Hey, clunker!"
"I'll give you a hand too! Let's hurry{n} up and scrap these machines getting{n} in the way of our ring hunt!"
"What are you saying, Mr. Robot?"
"Ever since we met you on this island,{n} you have saved us{n} sooo many times."
"So this time, it's our turn{n} to save yooou!"
"It is Lt. {hero:6}'s order!{n} FD-3S!{n} I will back you up too!"
"We've come this far together!{n} Machine or not, you're one of us.{n} I'll fight alongside you too!"
"All that has form breaks; such is the{n} way of the world. Then the Machine{n} Soldier before us can surely be felled."
"Master FD-3S, allow me to assist you."
"Well, Toryu? Can your blade cut{n} the Machine Soldier before us?"
"Then I am expecting much of you."
"I will go with you too, FD-3S.{n} Machine Soldier or not,{n} a comrade is a comrade."
"If anything, one untouched by the{n} sickness of the heart called evil may{n} be nearer to God than humans are."
"Nearer to God, huh..."
"Yes. Because FD-3S is not afflicted{n} with the sickness called evil,{n} the way you are, Mr. {hero:6}."
"Heh. Say whatever you like,{n} why don't you."
"I see... that's good, too...{n} ...To die... for your comrades...{n} A warrior's... way to die..."
"If I... die as a warrior...{n} ...would my sister... forgive me...{n} too... I wonder..."
"A question for the Creators, is it..."
"Very well, I will join the fight too!{n} The question FD-3S holds, I too{n} wish to ask the Creators!"
"The meaning of why we were made!"
"Heh heh, how my blood stirs.{n} I have not felt this since the{n} Ordoba War a hundred years ago."
"Your blood stirs...?"
"Does that happen even to{n} someone as calm as you, Mr. Faust?"
"Miss Aerial, I am human too. I do have{n} feelings: joy, anger, sorrow, delight."
"I am surprised. I had thought you{n} a more level-headed, composed,{n} cool sort of person, Mr. Faust."
"You think too highly of me.{n} I am a far more worldly creature."
"But I am glad."
"Oh?"
"Somehow, all of a sudden, you feel{n} so much closer to me, Mr. Faust..."
"Still, ten thousand years ago!{n} FD-3S, your memory is much, much{n} too good, yes indeed!"
"Why, Li'l Tethys forgets even{n} yesterday before she knows it!"
"Well, your case is a liiittle{n} special, Tethys dear..."
"Oh my, my, my? Is that so?{n} Maybe so, if you please!{n} No, it might well be so, yes indeed!"
"C'mon, c'mon, c'mon, c'mon, c'mon!"
"Super A-class droid or whatever the{n} hell you are, my heavy MG'll make{n} a honeycomb of you quick! Get ready!"
"Ahem! I'm a professor, you know!"
"From the standpoint of Item Studies,{n} however high-spec a machine may be,{n} it's bound to have a weak point!"
"I'm a made person too, you know!{n} So I feel a whoooole lot of{n} 'kindship' with FD-3S!"
"'Kindship'?"
"Geez! Don't pick on me, my prince!{n} I just got it wrong, okay?{n} I meant 'kinsip'!"
"It's 'kinship'... come on..."
"Indeed. I, too, am a human who was{n} made. The doubt FD-3S harbors,{n} I understand painfully well..."
"All right, is everybody ready!?"
"Everyone, are you all ready?"
"Thank you."
"Now I understand clearly.{n} I wanted to become human."
"To worry, grieve, laugh, rage, weep;{n} to bear a heart complex, simple,{n} impulsive, and full of chaos..."
"And yet, with no regard for their own{n} lives, at times they show the{n} kindness of helping a comrade."
"The countless questions born in my{n} heart all come down to one. This is{n} what I wanted to ask the Creators:"
"Can I, someday, become human?"
"Tch! Pipe down, clunker!{n} The enemy's your own kind, isn't it?{n} Hurry up and get ready to fight!"
"Let's save the talk for later,{n} Mr. Robot! For now, we deal with{n} the enemy in front of us!"
"Understood!"
"Foolish creatures, humans."
"FD-3S, comrade of foolish creatures."
"I will simply erase you both!"
"I will not be erased!{n} Not when I have comrades{n} to protect to the end!"
"The enemy boss can wait!{n} First we clear out the small fry!"
"The enemy boss can wait!{n} First, the Machine Soldiers{n} all around us!"
"No! SA-22C comes first!{n} That electron accelerator is truly{n} a one-hit-kill special ability!"
"Quickly, before it is used!"
"Not bad, humans.{n} And you, defective FD-3S."
"To think I would end up showing{n} all of my functions{n} against the likes of these..."
"Very well!"
"Boost limiter fully released!{n} Twin rotor output: 270%! Electron{n} accelerator engages in 10 seconds!"
"What are you up to!?"
"What's about to staaart?"
"This is bad!"
"Electron accelerator: engage!"
"What is wrong!? What are you doing!?{n} You humans look to me as if{n} you were standing still!"
"Enemy combat power up to 9800!{n} Speed: 88 times normal!{n} Our victory probability: 0.03%!"
"As expected of a super A-class droid!"
"However!"
"Boost limiter released!"
"Main engine: beginning shift{n} from Unit L-13 to Unit L-20!"
"...Connected!"
"Triple rotor engaged!"
"Sequential turbo at full throttle!"
"Output: 555%!"
"Start!"
"Kh!? It's moving too fast!?{n} I can't get a lock on it like this!"
"It's moving faaar too fast!{n} We can't attack like thiiis!"
"I have waited long, FD-3S!{n} At last you too have come inside{n} this electron-accelerated space!"
"I cannot simply stand by in silence{n} and watch my comrades{n} be hurt any longer!"
"But now the conditions are even.{n} At last we can settle the score{n} from ten thousand years ago..."
"It cannot be? SA-22C?{n} Was that your intent{n} from the very start?"
"And if it was?"
"Then you, moved only by your own{n} hatred, are nothing but a defective,{n} the same as I am!"
"A defective! So be it! So long{n} as I can settle things with you!"
"That is what I want as well!"
"This pain! The same as 10,000 years{n} ago! Our battle, carved in my{n} photon memory... I remember it!"
"But you cannot win! The victory{n} probability favors me as well!"
"The potential of the human heart{n} cannot be measured by{n} probability or calculation!"
"But you are a machine!"
"No! {hero:6} and the others{n} taught me the human heart!{n} So I will never lose!"
"No! {name:6} and the others{n} taught me the human heart!{n} So I will never lose!"
"Unscientific nonsense!"
"Uoooooooooooh!?"
"Why... why..."
"All my functions... are stopping...{n} ...The main engine... photon memory...{n} every function... in my body..."
"Why... me... an eternal machine?"
"To be eternal is to refuse change.{n} And so there is no growth, either."
"I will walk alongside people."
"Alongside people, troubled and hurt,{n} I will live on toward tomorrow.{n} Even if what lies ahead is death."
"Are you saying... one grows...{n} ...only by accepting... death?"
"...So that is why... we..."
"Huh?"
"What the hell just happened?{n} Tell me, FD-3S.{n} Where did the enemy boss go?"
"Rest assured. It is all over.{n} Yes, in the time it took you{n} to blink, {hero:6}..."
"A fight to the death in one blink.{n} It resembles a human life.{n} A faint flash, like a spark."
"Ten thousand years, and a mere 0.1{n} seconds. A gulf to make the mind reel."
"But I would choose a moment's flash{n} over eternal stillness. If that{n} is the way humans live."
"What are you talking about?"
"It is all right. It is over now.{n} And it is a beginning: a new{n} journey for a new me..."
"Oh myyy?"
"What on earth happeeened?{n} Come on, tell me, Mr. Robot."
"Come to think of it, I don't see{n} the enemy boss anywhere{n} either, you knooow?"
"Rest assured. It is all over.{n} Yes, in the time it took you{n} to blink, {name:6}..."
"A fight to the death in one blink.{n} It resembles a human life.{n} A faint flash, like a spark."
"Ten thousand years, and a mere 0.1{n} seconds. A gulf to make the mind reel."
"But I would choose a moment's flash{n} over eternal stillness. If that{n} is the way humans live."
"What do you meaaan?"
"It is all right. It is over now.{n} And it is a beginning: a new{n} journey for a new me..."
"Looks like that one's{n} the enemy leader."
"So that is the enemy leader."
"My name is SA-22C."
"My code is Strike Attacker,{n} Type 22, Custom Type. A super A-class{n} droid built for attack power."
"One of the eternal machines{n} that defend this island."
"Heh. Eternal, my ass."
"Seems you've been on this island{n} for ages, but relax. I'll finish off{n} that 'eternity' of yours myself."
"Eternal, is iiit..."
"But if you won't step aside, I'm{n} terribly sorry, but your eternity{n} will end right heeere..."
"You say you will end my eternity?{n} That is far too illogical.{n} Defective humans cannot do it."
"Then I'll make it possible."
"Then I'll try making it possible!"
"Humans, those foolish creatures,{n} shall be erased completely{n} from the face of the earth!"
"The enemy boss can wait!{n} First we clear out the small fry!"
"The enemy boss can wait!{n} First, the Machine Soldiers{n} all around us!"
"Why... why..."
"The greatest failure the Creators{n} ever made... Why would I fall{n} to mere humans?"
"I... an eternal machine...?"
"Nothing in this world is eternal.{n} If anything is, it's only death:{n} the end that goes on forever."
"You there, machine bastard. You die{n} here, and you'll never come back.{n} That's the eternity you wanted."
"All that lives must die someday.{n} All that has form must break someday."
"A simple truth that everyone knows...{n} Why did your Creators{n} never notice it, I wonder..."
"Was I... a defective too...?{n} ...Like the many machines... and{n} humans... the Creators made..."
"What's wrong, clunker?"
"Hm. Unit L-20 appears to be{n} completely destroyed. It does not{n} respond to self-repair, either..."
"So that means... you're done for good?"
"No, it is nothing serious. It should{n} not hinder normal operations."
"However, starting and sustaining{n} the electron-accelerated state{n} will likely be impossible."
"Hmph... I don't really get it,{n} but if you can move, fine by me."
"And another thing..."
"What is it?"
"...That fight just now.{n} Looks like you saved me."
"I'll say thanks, for what it's worth."
"Um, Mr. Robot...{n} thank you very much."
"Why do you thank me, {name:6}?"
"Even I count as a swordswoman, you{n} knooow. In that fight, if not for you,{n} Mr. Robot, who knows what..."
"I can tell that muuuch!"
"The battle with it... with SA-22C...{n} was practically my own doing."
"Had I not been there, it would not{n} have pushed itself that far..."
"Pushed itself..."
"In that battle, it activated its{n} electron acceleration function."
"To counter it, I had no choice{n} but to accelerate as well, but..."
"Electron acceleration puts abnormal{n} stress on a Machine Soldier's body."
"I passed the ages shut down, with{n} little wear on my parts, and so{n} I barely withstood it, but"
"having kept running for 10,000 years,{n} it must have taken excessive stress."
"In other words, its wish to settle{n} things with me clouded its judgment."
"Huuh? I don't really understand, but{n} I'm glad you're safe, Mr. Robot."
"...I am not exactly... unharmed."
"I, too, took damage{n} to Unit L-20."
"Electron acceleration can{n} no longer be executed."
"Whaaat!? A-a-are you all riiight!?"
"No, it is nothing serious. It should{n} not hinder normal operations."
"Phew, what a reliiief!"
"But Mr. Robot, please don't{n} push yourself too hard, okay?"
"......Thank you."
"Me, getting pushed back?{n} Somebody cover me!"
"So strong! They're waaay too strong!?"
"No! I can't give up now!{n} Hector, cover me, pleeease!"
"Tch, not bad!"
"But I absolutely can't lose this!{n} Back me up, will you!"
"Backup! Backup!{n} Waaah! It hurts!{n} But Alice won't give up!"
"Well fought, for an enemy.{n} {name:6}, forgive me,{n} but I need your support!"
"Argh! Son of a bitch!{n} But I won't lose! Never again!{n} Backup! Send help!!"
"Am I... out of healing...?{n} ...Please... cover me..."
"Oh dear, this won't do...{n} I have run out of ways to heal."
"I'm a professor, you know!?{n} Show a little more care, will you!?{n} Hurry up and back me up!"
"Win probability down to 22%!{n} Auto-repair function: off!!{n} Requesting backup!"
"The flow of ki is gathering to the{n} enemy. I have no means of healing{n} left. Please, lend me your support."
"Mm...{n} ...Support...!"
"Lord, please send me aid!{n} I cannot lose here, for I{n} must spread Your teachings!"
"Ngh, they really are strong!{n} And I'm out of healing...{n} Backup, please!"
"Me, a soldier of Romulus, pushed{n} back by a mere foe like this...!{n} Sorry, requesting relief!"
"Li'l Tethys is in a piiinch!{n} Backup, if you please!!{n} Much obliged, yes indeed!"
"Gh...{w:1} Why...{w:1} Me, of all people..."
"I'm sorry...{w:1} Hector..."
"Guess they were...{w:1} way out of my league.{n} Sorry, I'm pulling out first!"
"Uu...{w:3} sniff...{w:3} sniff...{n} Alice...{w:3} lost...{n} Alice is going... {w:5}home..."
"Alas...{w:3} so I am beaten.{n} Forgive me, {w:3}I must withdraw."
"I can...{w:3} still fight...{w:3} I can...{n} ...Damn it! {w:3}Pulling back for now!"
"Pathetic...{w:3} Can't even die...{n} So once again, I alone {w:3}retreat...?"
"It seems...{w:3} over these centuries...{n} my magic, too...{w:3} has waned...{n} Allow me {w:3}to withdraw first!"
"Why...{w:3} did I...{w:3} lose?{n} I'm...{w:3} a professor, I tell you...{n} Retreat, {w:3}retreat! {w:3}Running is winning!"
"Damage rate...{w:3} 59.7%...{n} Self-repair {w:3}limit reached.{n} Moving to camp."
"I could not...{w:3} control the flow of ki...{n} ...{w:3}I can make...{w:3} no excuses.{n} I will...{w:3} return...{w:3} ahead of you..."
"Defeat...{n} {w:3}Withdrawing..."
"Ah...{w:3} so I have lost...{n} Lord, {w:3}forgive me...{n} I will go back {w:3}to camp {w:3}ahead of you..."
"Ngh...{w:3} I'm sorry...{n} {hero:6}...{w:3} Lieutenant, sir...{n} I'm pulling back {w:3}ahead of you..."
"...{w:3}A proud...{w:3} soldier of Romulus,{n} beaten...{w:3} so disgracefully...{n} Sorry... {w:3}I'm withdrawing!!"
"Li'l Tethys loses!{n} Withdrawing, if you please!!{n} The rest is yours, yes indeed!"
